 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. On Tuesday (3), Internacional beat Coritiba 1–0 at Beira-Rio in Matchday 34 of the Brasileirão.
 Alerrandro scored the goal that brought relief to Inter fans, converting a penalty conceded in stoppage time by center-back Rodrigo Moledo, an Inter fan favorite who made nearly 250 appearances for the club from Rio Grande do Sul between 2010 and 2023.
 All of this, coupled with the fact that the win lifted Internacional out of the relegation zone, set social media buzzing late into the night.
